pins.definition: Costing a lot of money; high in price.

situation: A well-dressed woman stands at a jewellery counter in a high-end boutique, staring at a small digital register screen showing an extremely high total.
subject: the high price
brief: A woman in a tailored coat stares at a sleek payment terminal on a glass counter, where a long row of illuminated zero digits trails off the screen. The clerk stands quietly behind the counter with hands folded, while the shop interior is spare and intensely bright.
prompt: A woman in a tailored coat stares at a sleek payment terminal on a glass counter, where a long row of illuminated zero digits trails off the screen. The clerk stands quietly behind the counter with hands folded, while the shop interior is spare and intensely bright. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
